messages.text: Please add a Tournament mode for 4 or 8 players sharing one device. A Tournament button next to New Game opens it. Players choose 4 or 8 with a Players select, type names into inputs labelled Player 1 to Player 8, and press Start tournament. It's a knockout: in each match both players play the same deal, one after the other, and fewer moves wins. Show whose turn it is as "Now playing: NAME". A Start turn button begins each player's game. When a game ends a Next turn button appears, and when a match ends a Next match button appears. A Leave tournament button stops it early. Show the bracket with each match's players, their moves and time, and its winner, and "Champion: NAME" at the end with a Back to game button. Finished tournaments stay in a Past tournaments list on the Tournament screen after reload. Every Tournament screen has an Export tournament button that puts JSON in a Tournament JSON box, and a Load tournament button that reads that box back. Please follow the project rules.

Tournament mode is complete. It supports four or eight players, shared deals for each match, knockout brackets, early exit, and a champion screen. Completed tournaments remain in Past tournaments after reload. Tournament JSON can be exported and loaded, including during an active turn.

Ties on moves are decided by time; an exact tie advances the first player. Tournaments use the grid size selected in the main game.

Verification passed: 143 unit and static tests, all 79 browser tests on the named runtime combination, type checking, and formatting.
